messages.subject: Normality for residual distributions
parts:
Hello,
I have questions about normality for residual distributions. First, is that the models still use the assumptions of normality for residual distributions? If so, How can I visualize some of the linear models of the OTUs and their residuals/q-q plots? And what can I do if some of the OTUs abundances is drastically violating the assumptions of normality? 

I hope for hearing from you soon. Thanks a lot.
HM Z
